$comment: CODEX-derived per D-59 (Phase 18.B): output shape of every SKILL-scaffold-* run. Mirrors codex's SCAFFOLDER_DESIGN.md 'summary report (JSON) of generated artifacts' surface but reshaped as canonical DEVAI evidence (additionalProperties:false, semver, explicit pattern for skill_id).
title: Scaffold Evidence
description: Required output of any SKILL-scaffold-* skill (Phase 18.F). Records what was generated, from what blueprint, with which template ids and token substitutions. INV-SCAFFOLD-001 requires every scaffolded artifact's generated header to match this record's blueprint_id + blueprint_version + blueprint_sha256 trio. Per D-59; per Article 32 (evidence schema discipline).

blueprint_version.description: SemVer from blueprint.module.version. Headers emitted into scaffolded files cite this; drift between header and current blueprint version is hard-fail under INV-SCAFFOLD-001.

blueprint_sha256.description: Canonical-JSON SHA-256 of the blueprint at scaffold time. Anchors INV-SCAFFOLD-001 drift detection.

stack_adapter_pack.description: Matched stack-adapter pack id (e.g. redox-pack-nestjs-postgres-react), or null when no pack matched (manual scaffolding path).

files_created.description: Repo-relative paths created by this scaffolder run.

files_modified.description: Repo-relative paths modified by this scaffolder run. Distinct from files_created so idempotency analysis is unambiguous.

template_id.description: Template registry id from the pack's templates field (e.g. 'db.migration', 'api.controller').

rendered_to.description: Repo-relative path the template rendered to.

rendered_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the rendered output (post token-substitution). Enables byte-identity idempotency checks across re-runs.

token_map.description: The token → value map applied during rendering (e.g. __NAMESPACE__ → 'demo', __MODULE__ → 'Greeter'). Forensic; lets a reader reconstruct what generated each file.

idempotency.description: fresh: first generation; no-op: re-run with same blueprint version and matching content hashes (no writes); drift-detected: re-run with bumped version or non-matching hashes (writes a diff report instead of overwriting).

drift_report.description: Populated only when idempotency=drift-detected. Each entry names a file whose on-disk content disagrees with what the template engine would render now.
